_comment: Shared base config (default team corp_id prefilled). Multi-bot instances inherit login/Cookie from this file via _merge_auth_from. No accounts, passwords, tokens or cookies are stored here; cookies are written by mcp_auth after QR-login.
_path_note: cache.cookie_path 留空即可 —— 由运行时按本机实际位置解析；填绝对路径会与他人机器不兼容，也是本包明令禁止的写法。

_choose_one.use_default_team_instance: Keep the corp_id below as-is. Other users in the same team can use the skill out of the box.
_choose_one.use_your_own_corp: Replace corp_id with <YOUR_CORP_ID>. The default Tech-agent UUID in config.tech-agent.json is for the default team only; pair it with your own config.tech-agent.json (override agent.uuid).

_session_placeholder: Optional: leave as {} to inherit; runtime reads/writes session fields here.
